title: Blue Mountain Beach "Surf Shack" 34 Seaward Drive
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "Surf Shack" 34 Seaward Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach- Gated community- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 1 umbrella (Mar 1-Oct 31)- Private heated pool **Pool heating available Oct 1–May 1 for $60 per day**- Stainless steel kitchen appliances- 5 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant—ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Guests will fall in love with the beauty and playfulness of Surf Shack, a 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom cottage in Dune Allen Beach that sleeps 12. Surf Shack is a quick walk to dedicated beach access and has a beautiful private pool, multiple porches, and a ping pong table. Charming landscaping and twisted oak trees shade a peaceful front porch with a classic porch swing. Inside, guests will find an uncluttered open living, kitchen, and dining area, with pops of color and luxurious details. A primary bedroom has a king bed, a 50” Smart TV, French doors that open to the back porch, and a private bathroom with a shower. A guest bedroom has a king bed and access to a common area shower. In the living area, guests can prepare a drink at the dry bar, using the wine chiller, and relax on a slipcovered sofa while enjoying a movie on a 65” Smart TV. The kitchen has a raised bar that seats 4, premium appliances, a Wolf gas oven with griddle, and granite countertops. Open shelving above the sink mimics the exposed ceiling beams in the living area, and an alcove with porch views has a roll-up window that adds a bright red punch to an otherwise white space. Open it up, and guests outside can belly up to the bar and share a meal with friends eating inside. The long back porch is a great place to spend hot afternoons. Guests can grill a burger, catch a game on the 50” TV, or relax in the Adirondack chairs. Steps lead to a deck with chaise lounge chairs, a ping pong table, and a beautiful pool. 2 guest rooms and a bunk room enjoy balcony views and a private living area on the second floor. At the top of the stair landing is a cozy living area with a wrap-around sofa facing a 50” TV and a wet bar with a beverage fridge. French doors open to a dreamy balcony with chair swings and a bed swing—an ideal place to unwind after a long day of play. A guest bedroom with 2 twin beds shares a bathroom with a second guest bedroom with a king bed and French doors that open to a front balcony. Along the hallway, a sliding wall panel cleverly conceals a bunk room with 3 twin beds and a twin trundle. Guests can easily explore the 30A bike path and Dune Allen Beach restaurants and shopping on 5 included adult bikes. Surf Shack also includes beach equipment and SUP boards! This delightful beach cottage is in the heart of a bustling community and is steps from the beach! Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed- Guest Bathroom: Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Sleeping Area: 3 Twin Beds and Twin Trundle- Guest Bathroom: Shower OnlyNEARBY ATTRACTIONS: - Yoga Studio & Gym (Steps Away)- Gulf Place Restaurants and Shopping (Steps Away) - Santa Rosa Country Club and Golf Course and The Vue Restaurant (One Mile) - Longleaf Greenway Western Bike Trail (Steps Away) Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
